title: OG native dependency guard recognizes real macOS libvips artifacts

source.ref: Local compiled artifact native traces and planted fixtures

detail: The guard only recognized Linux libvips-cpp.so and falsely reported20 local card routes missing sharp even though their traces carried sharp-darwin-x64.node and libvips-cpp.8.18.7.dylib. Match native Linux and macOS library basenames, keeping the same coverage floors and inheritance budget. Two planted Mac regressions fail before and all10 gate tests pass after; real artifact reports20 rasterisers and19 incidental carriers. Full local postbuild passes. This is local artifact evidence, not a production dependency incident.
